name: register-tab
blurb: Tabbed login/register form with OAuth providers and email/password fields.
description: A two-panel form using TabsProvider. Login tab has email, password, and OAuth buttons (Google, Apple, Facebook). Register tab includes username, phone with icon, email, password, and OAuth buttons. Dark/light theme aware.
use_when: Auth pages needing a unified login/register experience with social sign-in options.
avoid_when: If you need stronger security (forms lack CSRF protection and submission handling); this is a UI template.
a11y: Tab navigation requires TabsBtn and TabsContent structure. Input fields have placeholders and proper types. All buttons are keyboard-accessible.
